description: Weighted lists of story-room placements, selected from the current demo's room-condition id.

ID.technical: FName row key in StoryRoomConditionDataTables (DTM +0x860). Story_PickRoomPlacement_13097C0 computes a condition id from demo progress (default ROOM_COND_0000) and resolves it here; exported values ROOM_COND_0000..0066 and StoryDemo.Id_StoryRoomCondition references them.

Id_StoryRoomPlacement.simple: Candidate StoryRoomPlacement rows for this condition.
Id_StoryRoomPlacement.technical: TArray<FName> (row +0x10, eight exported slots). The weighted picker walks entries from index 0 until the first None, stops, and returns the chosen id; a row with no non-None candidate returns NAME_None. This id is then stored in GameManager.StudioStoryRoomPlacementId_D18 and resolved to levels/actors.

Weights.technical: TArray<float> (row +0x20). Story_PickRoomPlacement sums the weights for the non-None candidate prefix, rolls StoryFRand() * total, then walks the weights subtracting until the roll falls inside a slot; the last slot is the fallback. Weights[i] is read without its own bounds check, so the array must stay aligned with the placement ids. All exported weights are 1.0, making the current data a uniform pick.

notes: The condition id itself is chosen before this row is loaded: pending main demos in chapter 6 / CHAP_0007 use the last cleared demo's condition, an all-cleared state uses a uniform pick over all demo conditions (or keeps the saved placement when bPickWhenAllCleared is false). Source/Abrams/Private/StoryLaunchHelpers.cpp:218-290.
row constructor is empty; no default candidate or weight is inserted in C++ (Source/AbramsDataTable/Private/GameDataTableRow_StoryRoomCondition.cpp:3).
67 exported rows, all with eight placement slots and eight 1.0 weights; no numbered shards or locale variants.

Evidence is from the reconstructed C++ in Source/ (row shape/counts from the exported table); status/ records byte matches for some owner TUs, but this file does not claim a retail byte comparison for every function or exhaustive Blueprint/runtime coverage.

usages.detail: Story_PickRoomPlacement computes the condition, then picks a weighted placement id from this table.
Story_ResolveDemoLaunch stores the chosen placement in GameManager before building the phase request.
Story_GetRoomPlacementLevels resolves the chosen placement to level names.
